name: 結華
text:
ひどいよプロデューサーっ……！
私との約束、忘れちゃうなんてっ……！
trans:
You're such a jerk, Producer...!
I can't believe you'd break your promise...!

name: 結華
text:
……なーんちゃってぇ、ビックリした？
Ｐ氏も人間だもんね、またスケジュール調整お願いします！
trans:
...Juuust kidding, did I scare you? You're only human,
I get it. Just, please remember to adjust my
schedule next time!
